info.title: Veyndo studio: Merchant overview, reports, private staging shops and history
info.description: Generated by scripts/sdks/contracts.py; do not edit. HTTP bodies are open JSON (the handlers take serde_json::Value); typed schemas are the native MCP tool contracts in x-veyndo-tools, called through POST /mcp.

Problem.description: One safe, actionable failure; never contains SQL or provider payloads.

code.description: HTTP status code as a string (compatible legacy field)

details.description: Explicit bounded product catalogue preview; default comparisons contain no values

Tenant.name: x-tenant
Tenant.description: Shop ID. Required for shop-scoped calls without a session that already selects one.

personalSession.description: Personal merchant session token from POST /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register.

integrationKey.description: Scoped integration key from POST /api/workspace/integrations; intersects its creator's current membership.

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.history
x-veyndo-tools.description: Read scoped entity change summaries; no credential snapshots

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.history.restore
x-veyndo-tools.description: Restore reviewed content as a new revision through domain validation; orders excluded

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.grid.plan
x-veyndo-tools.description: Plan read-only native list filters; review criteria before applying

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.site.task
x-veyndo-tools.description: Export a credential-free native shop design task

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.site.propose
x-veyndo-tools.description: Validate a coding-agent page result for explicit review

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.site.apply
x-veyndo-tools.description: Approve a scoped shop-design proposal in staging

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.reports.read
x-veyndo-tools.description: Read bounded sales, channel and consent-aware traffic reports

x-veyndo-tools.name: studio.workspace.work.read
x-veyndo-tools.description: Read bounded actionable work from current authorized shop data

x-veyndo-tools.name: studio.workspace.read
x-veyndo-tools.description: Read the current personal Studio workspace

x-veyndo-tools.name: studio.workspace.save
x-veyndo-tools.description: Revise the current personal Studio workspace

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.import.inspect
x-veyndo-tools.description: Read current mapped target fields and report missing/changed imports without writing

x-veyndo-tools.name: merchant.import.record
x-veyndo-tools.description: Explicitly import a source record through current domain permissions; historical orders have no purchase effects
